special_traits.name: Pack Tactics
special_traits.description:
The hobgoblin has Advantage on an at-
tack roll against a creature if at least one of the hobgoblin's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12
(2d10 + 1) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description:

son damage.
